snippet.title: C64 Battle of Britain - Making enemy plane go down without single shoot!
snippet.description:
Not sure if this is bug or feature, but it was possible to shoot down enemy plane without single shot, when in cockpit view fight :)

To do it you need to keep enemy plane on the bottom of the cockpit but it must be visible. It doesn't matter if in middle left or right. But when on side its better visible :)
